evidence.quote: Our tuition fees are €9,300 per semester.
We accept applications from October 15, 2026 until May 15, 2027.
Create an account in our application portal
Prepare a CV (see required application documents and CV example)
Prepare a letter of motivation (see required application documents)
We require a secondary school diploma or equivalent higher education entrance qualification (e.g., IB, Abitur, A-Levels).

notes: applicationChannel: The pages do not mention uni-assist or a VPD for this programme. They describe applying directly via the university's own application portal ("our application portal"), so de-university-direct is used. Tuition: the €9,300 per semester fee is stated on the WHU Bachelor fees page without excluding non-EU applicants; the DAAD page gives a different figure (9,100 EUR per semester) for "all countries". The €9,300 per semester figure is included here. Documents: The English application page names the required application documents as a CV, a letter of motivation and a secondary school diploma, but the detailed list is in a linked PDF ("Application documents (pdf)") that is not part of the supplied text. The French page names "Lebenslauf", "Motivationsschreiben" and "Hochschulzugangsberechtigung" but no translation requirement.

note.fr: Un stage ou apprentissage de six semaines en gestion/économie, ou une expérience pratique équivalente, est exigé. Une confirmation doit être fournie avant le 15 mai.
note.en: A six-week internship or apprenticeship in business administration/management, or equivalent practical experience, is required. Confirmation must be submitted by May 15.

evidence.quote: Internship of six weeks, or equivalent practical experience prior to the beginning of the programme

note.fr: Après avoir postulé en ligne, vous devez passer un test analytique, une évaluation en ligne et un entretien individuel.
note.en: After applying online, you must complete an analytical test, an online assessment and a one-on-one interview.
